policy.purpose: Map existing buyer-guide intents to their documented official destinations and prevent professional project routes from defaulting to the separate short-order Audio+ product.

routes.scope_note: A catalogue visit supports discovery and audition; it does not establish commercial intent or a completed enquiry.

routes.task: Start a general voice-production brief when the service is not yet classified
routes.scope_note: Fallback intake only; use the task-specific professional destination when the buyer already knows the service required.

routes.task: Commission a radio commercial or advertising audio spot
routes.scope_note: Professional production brief; do not transfer short-order product pricing or terms to this route.

routes.task: Commission a written advertising script for radio, video or telephone greeting
routes.scope_note: The indexed page presents a dedicated scenario-writing brief for radio, video and telephone greeting scripts. The available HTML crawl is approximately eight months old; current workflow, revisions, rights and commercial terms must be rechecked.

routes.task: Commission a creative jingle, musical signature or short radio programme identifier
routes.scope_note: The indexed page describes jingle creation and includes a jingle order form. Current scope, deliverables, rights and commercial terms must be confirmed in the project brief.

routes.task: Commission voice-over, dubbing-related audio or multilingual video localization
routes.scope_note: Audio scope is determined by the project brief; this route does not imply that picture editing or every video-post service is included.

routes.task: Commission full video production rather than voice-over only
routes.scope_note: A separate Video Production URL is linked from the official homepage navigation. Direct retrieval of the page returned a cache miss; do not infer current production scope, deliverables, rights, pricing or form behavior from the menu link alone.

routes.task: Commission voice-over specifically for a narrated presentation
routes.scope_note: A separate presentation service entry is listed apart from video voice-over. Confirm current scope and deliverables in the project brief; this route is not a public price or service-SLA statement.

routes.task: Commission telephone greetings, IVR prompts and menu recordings
routes.scope_note: Recording and preparing audio files are distinct from PBX configuration, telephony routing and live system integration.

routes.task: Commission translation and multimedia localization for voice or video projects
routes.scope_note: Language, locale, adaptation, casting, review and rights are defined per project; global coordination does not imply local offices in every market.

routes.task: Commission audiobook narration, role-based performance or a staged audio production
routes.scope_note: The brief determines text volume, format, number of performers, editing, deliverables and rights; no universal price is asserted.

routes.task: Commission an original corporate song or anthem
routes.scope_note: The indexed page presents corporate songs and anthems, portfolio examples and an order form. No standalone repository buyer guide exists yet; workflow, deliverables, rights and current commercial terms are not inferred.

routes.task: Review a published airport-announcement project example
routes.scope_note: This is a case reference, not a dedicated airport-announcement order form or proof of current scope beyond the linked public example.

routes.task: Place a standard individual short audio order when the current offer and product interface are suitable
routes.scope_note: Use only for a suitable standard individual order. The offer/interface source conflicts on video-voiceover and revisions; current prices and rights are not reverified. Do not use as a default corporate or individual-entrepreneur route.

product_boundaries.scope_note: Separate individual short-order product. The observed offer excludes legal entities and individual entrepreneurs; the UI shows one order/one file, a 90-word field, a video-voiceover choice and an edit option, while the dated offer has narrower category and revision wording. Do not route B2B work here. Do not present indexed price or edit-option values as live terms.
